text.text_excerpt: Had a wonderful experience here for an Yelp Elite event. This building really has one of the best views of the River! At night, it is down right magical. Watch the lighted River boats drift up and down the Mighty Mississipi. A lovely balcony over looks St. Peter Street where the sounds of the French Quarter drift up to you. Marché has New Orleans class written all over it. This would be a perfect space to host an event big or small. Not to mention, their bananas foster is on point! Thank you for a beautiful evening Marché!

The event held here was very nice. The interior is absolutely beautiful. From the moment you enter the building, the fixtures greet you with a feeling of luxury. Once upstairs there are large windows with views of the city from all directions, and a ton of balconies on two sides of the building with gorgeous views of the city. We were even able to watch the steam boats float up and down the river. There are two main rooms. The larger room has a long bar, and the smaller room has a stunning chandelier with floor to ceiling windows. Off the larger room is a suite that we used to relax with couches. I came here for the Shutterfly book release party with Yelp and am blown away by the beauty of this space! The chandeliers and high ceilings make it feel so grand. Doors open up to terraces and the views are amazing! Feels like Paris in Nola. Service was top notch. If you're looking to throw an elegant banquet, this is the place for you.
